entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Alex Chen. Order number is VF-2025-99812.
Thank you, Alex. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. Is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
The pulse reading is garbage. It's defective.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I'd be happy to walk you through a couple of quick troubleshooting steps. It might be a simple calibration we can fix over the phone.
Look, I don't have time for all that. I just want my money back. The thing doesn't work. I need a refund.
I understand you're frustrated and just want this resolved. Let me quickly review the return eligibility for your order. Please hold for one moment.

Okay, thank you for your patience, Alex. I've checked our policy, and I see that your delivery date was 22 days ago. You're still well within our 90-day return window, so I can absolutely process this return for you.
Fine. About time. Send me the label.

Of course. I've just initiated that for you. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Once our warehouse receives the item, the refund will be credited back to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
